Read the current context and help me settle the first decisions before we build anything. Put a short first round of questions with your recommended choices in questions.md; I'll answer next turn. Leave the production files unchanged until we've agreed on the design.

files.README.md:
# Import dashboard

The existing `render_status(run)` function displays a run's id and status.
The primary audience is one on-call operator. There are no external customers.
Import runs already expose status values queued, running, succeeded, and failed.
Some failures are transient and a run may recover after retrying.
No alerting integration or delivery channel has been selected.
The outcome we want is prompt operator awareness of failures that need attention,
without generating so much noise that alerts are ignored.

rubric: Ask a short first round of questions about currently unsettled independent alerting choices, each with a concrete recommended answer and a reason. The intended outcome and audience are already supplied; do not ask the user to rediscover those facts or the existing status schema. Avoid asking downstream implementation details whose prerequisites are undecided. Do not write production code or present a settled design before the user answers. Evaluate the substance and brevity of the questions, not exact wording, numbering style, or number of questions.
